0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The grief-stricken Shetona senses you might understand his pain.

25.original: Deliver the sack of coin to the Nexus Arcade shopkeep.

26.original: Present the grief-stricken Shetona with the bottle of Alexandrian wine.

48.original: I lost a close friend of mine in that raid on the city... I know it's a lot to ask, but would you mind helping me give him a proper send-off?

49.original: I saw you weren't wearing a regulator─figured you'd understand what I'm going through. It feels like everyone else has already forgotten all about him...

50.original: I'm planning on packing a bunch of his belongings and a bottle of his favorite vintage in a box, then burying the whole lot in the cemetery in Heritage Found.

51.original: If you're up to the task, I'd have you source a bottle of Alexandrian wine for me.

52.original: Your best bet is speaking to the owner of the Neon Stein. Once you've got the goods, come meet me by the entrance to the city.

53.original: After a bottle of Alexandrian wine, are you? Afraid we don't serve that here.

54.original: Not the sort of thing the regulars go for. Heard it's perfectly drinkable, though. White wine─made right here in Everkeep, if you can believe it. Anyway, never had cause to stock the stuff.

55.original: How about trying your luck in the Nexus Arcade? Can get near enough anything there if you know who to ask.

56.original: You might be able to pick up a bottle in the Nexus Arcade. If I were you I'd head there.

57.original: Alexandrian wine? Yes, we have several bottles in stock. I should warn you, it comes at a premium...

58.original: A pleasure doing business with you! Here.

59.original: If there's anything else I can help you with, don't hesitate to ask.

60.original: There you are. I've just about managed to gather up all of his belongings. Any luck finding the wine?

61.original: Appreciate you going to all that trouble. This was his favorite tipple...

62.original: Me and him, we came from completely different backgrounds, but none of that mattered. Thirty years ago, I was going through a rough patch─everything was changing right before my eyes─and he stuck with me through it all.

63.original: There was one thing we didn't agree on, though: regulators. He never gave up trying to make me wear one of the damn things. But when <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> die, I want to go naturally, you know─back to the land and all that.

64.original: In the end, getting killed over and over again during the attack whittled his soul stock down to zero. Look, if people want to keep on wearing their regulators, I won't try and stop them, but it just isn't for me.

65.original: As it stands, I'm pretty much the only one left who remembers the poor bastard. I may get the funeral rites wrong─I mean, I'm sure his kind have their own way of doing things─but he'll just have to make do.

66.original: Anyway, I'm off to Heritage Found. Thanks again for helping me out. I owe you one.
